contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17, possibly Lyon mint. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--]TIVS[--]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. In exergue: possibly PLG. Diameter: 16.2mm, Weight: 2.31gms, die…
